metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to decompress your back at home.

This spinal decompression exercise is geared towards relieving pressure in the spinal discs of the upper, middle, and lower back. How it works is through a pulling motion, or TRACTION. Think of a very good stretch that helps open up the spine.

This is effective in many ways, such as helping to decrease muscle and joint stiffness and taking pressure off pinched nerves (that may be causing sharp, shooting pains like sciatica). Also, you may find it gives back pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Great part is, all that's needed is a couch, bed, or Ottoman. 

Watch now and learn how to decompress your back at home! 

***************************
